outcome: mean weeks of gestation at delivery
uterine rupture during pregnancy or labor
cohort: 99 patients who underwent hysteroscopic metroplasty in a 5-year period (study group) and 4155 women, who gave birth in the same hospital in the same period (control group)
finding: The study found no difference in obstetric outcomes between women who had undergone hysteroscopic metroplasty for septate uterus and a control group.
mod_finding: While vaginal delivery appears safe after hysteroscopic metroplasty, rare but serious complications like uterine rupture should be considered.
birth_weight: mean birth weight measured, but no specific values reported
